title: $\boldsymbol{f}$-OPD: Stabilizing Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation with Freshness-Aware Control
abstract: arXiv:2605.17862v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling on-policy distillation (OPD) for large language models (LLMs) confronts a fundamental tension: asynchronous execution is necessary for system efficiency, but structurally deviates from the ideal on-policy objective. To address this challenge, we theoretically decompose the objective discrepancy into rollout drift and supervision drift, capturing staleness in student rollout and teacher context, respectively. Building on this, we introduce a sample-level freshness score that quantifies the reliability of a buffered sample with respect to the on-policy objective. Guided by this signal, we further propose f-OPD, a novel framework that adaptively regulates stale-sample influence and constrains policy drift accumulated under asynchronous training. translated_title: f-OPD：通过新鲜度感知控制稳定长时程在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 扩展大语言模型（LLM）的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）面临一个根本性矛盾：异步执行对系统效率是必要的，但在结构上偏离了理想的在线策略目标。为应对这一挑战，我们从理论上将目标偏差分解为 rollout 漂移和监督漂移，分别刻画学生 rollout 与教师上下文中的陈旧性问题。在此基础上，我们引入了样本级新鲜度分数，用以量化缓冲样本相对于在线策略目标的可靠性。在该信号的指导下，我们进一步提出了 f-OPD，这是一个新颖的框架，能够自适应地调节陈旧样本的影响，并约束异步训练中累积的策略漂移。在交互时程不断增加的推理、工具使用和编程智能体任务上，f-OPD 始终取得与同步优化相当的任务性能，同时大幅……
tldr: f-OPD 通过样本级新鲜度分数自适应调节陈旧样本的影响并约束异步训练中累积的策略漂移，使长时程在线策略蒸馏达到与同步优化相当的性能。
